title: pseolint AuditSummary (JSON output contract)
description: The stable public shape that `formatJson` (pseolint --format json) serializes. Programmatic consumers (CI gates, pseolint-gate-style scripts) should validate against this and branch on `schemaVersion`. `schemaVersion` bumps on every breaking OR additive-public output change. The engine emits additional internal/legacy fields not described here; `additionalProperties` is therefore permissive (true) so this schema pins the CONTRACT consumers gate on without rejecting forward-compatible additions.

schemaVersion.description: Output-contract version tag. Bumps on every breaking OR additive-public output change. Consumers MUST branch on this. Equal to the `$id` version segment.

verdict.description: User-facing verdict ladder, replacing the legacy numeric score as the human signal.

risk.description: Internal numeric risk score, 0-100, lower is better. Retained for CI thresholding, trend deltas, and alert-gate diff logic. Never shown to humans. When `truncated` is true, treat as a LOWER bound.

headline.description: One-line count summary, e.g. "3 ship-blockers, 16 should-fix".

categories.description: Per-category grade + raw issue count. Keyed by the 5 fixed category keys. NOTE: these objects carry grades/counts only, NOT the issue arrays (those live under `issues`). The `audit` category exists for completeness but is weight-0 and never affects the verdict.

issues.description: Findings bucketed by SEVERITY. This is the v0.4+ replacement for the flat `findings` array and is NOT category-keyed. To get a flat list for a gate: [...issues.blockers, ...issues.shouldFix, ...issues.informational].

blockers.description: Severity = error or critical. Must be fixed before shipping.

shouldFix.description: Severity = warning. Should be fixed before scaling.

informational.description: Severity = info. Tracked for trend analysis.

diagnostics.description: Engine-internal diagnostics (origin readiness, crawl stats, engine-emitted audit/* findings). Weight 0 — never affects the verdict. Shape is intentionally loose here; consumers should not gate on diagnostics internals.

pageCount.description: Number of pages audited this run. When `truncated` is true, the crawl did not complete, so treat as a LOWER bound.

templates.description: v0.6 per-template breakdown. Present on sites where the classifier found >=2 template clusters; an empty array (or omitted, on older blobs / tiny sites) means the per-URL findings carry everything. Additive: consumers reading only `issues`/`findings` still work.

templateDetected.description: True when the enrichment pipeline detected template-generated content.

rawFindingCount.description: Pre-enrichment finding count, for backward compatibility with CI scripts that counted raw findings before clustering collapsed them.

auditedUrls.description: URLs actually audited this run (after sampling, dedup, and policy filtering), sorted for deterministic diffs. Absent when no pages were audited.

skippedUrls.description: v0.5+ monitoring: URLs the change-driven matrix decided to skip pre-fetch (their findings were carried forward from prior state).

truncated.description: True when the run did NOT cover the full site — either the backpressure watchdog aborted a degraded-origin crawl, or discovery under-delivered against the declared sitemap (see truncatedKind). The report still carries whatever was collected. CI gates MUST treat coverage as PARTIAL: counts, `risk`, and `verdict` are LOWER bounds. Absent or false on complete runs.

truncatedReason.description: Human-readable reason the run was truncated. Present only when `truncated` is true.

truncatedKind.description: Machine-readable cause of truncation, present only when `truncated` is true. "backpressure" = watchdog aborted a degraded-origin crawl; "coverage" = discovery under-delivered vs the declared sitemap (unreachable child sitemaps or far fewer pages fetched than declared).

categoryGrade.description: Per-category letter grade + raw issue count.

issues.description: Raw count of findings contributing to this category.

ruleResult.description: A single rule finding. Only `ruleId`, `severity`, and `message` are guaranteed; all other fields are populated contextually by the rule and enrichment pipeline.

severity.description: Finding severity. blockers bucket = error|critical, shouldFix = warning, informational = info.

fix.description: What to do about this finding.

ref.description: Google documentation URL backing this finding.

pageUrl.description: Primary page this finding refers to, when applicable.

relatedUrls.description: Other URLs involved (cluster members, related pairs).

effort.description: Fix effort level assigned by the enrichment pipeline.

confidence.description: Confidence in this finding. Defaults to `high` when omitted.

template.description: v0.6: which template the finding belongs to. Absent for site-level findings.

carriedForward.description: v0.5+: true when carried forward from a prior audit without re-verification this run.

lastVerifiedAt.description: v0.5+: ISO timestamp of the last audit that re-fetched the page and confirmed this finding.

signature.description: Stable identifier derived from the URL pattern, e.g. "/listing/:slug".

totalUrls.description: Cluster size in the discovered URL set (NOT the audit sample).

totalDiscoveredUrls.description: Total discovered URLs (denominator for coverage % calculation).

auditedUrls.description: URLs actually audited for this template.

verdict.description: Per-template verdict, independent of site-level verdict.

risk.description: Per-template risk score (0-100), independent of site-level risk.

variance.description: Per-template fire-rate variance across the sampled pages.

ruleFireRates.description: Per-rule fire-rate within the template, e.g. {"spam/thin-content": 0.8}.

uniformityScore.description: 0-1, higher = more uniform quality across the template's pages.

topDriver.description: Worst-firing rule + its rate, or null when no rule fired.

findingIds.description: Finding IDs whose pageUrl is in auditedUrls. Reference, not duplication.
